scope: Independent saved-record integrity and common-pack recomputation; no product or model execution
archive_equality: Original relative paths and SHA256 below must match archive-manifest.json and extracted raw.tar.xz; archival is performed separately by root
limitations: Real source snippets with automatically authored identifier queries; single-repository hypothesis-aligned retrieval pilot
No generated answers, patches, task-test success, longitudinal user evaluation or universal competitor advantage
Lookup timing and initialization boundaries differ across engines; audit rechecks saved arithmetic only
Actual-import and kernel launch provenance is corroborated by saved metadata, bound code and saved Book archives, not external process attestation
Search ranking was not rerun; original selected IDs were independently mapped and repacked
Repeated queries and variants are correlated, not independent real-user tasks

auditor.source:
"""Saved-record integrity audit only: no product imports, searches or timings."""
from pathlib import Path
import ast
import collections
import hashlib
import json
import math
import re
import sqlite3
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

import tiktoken
import tiktoken.load

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RAW = ROOT / ".artifacts/round7-identifiers-first"
DESTINATION = ROOT / "benchmarks/reports/round7-identifiers-integrity-audit.json"
ARCHIVE_PREFIX = "benchmarks/reports/round7-identifiers-first"


def digest(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def encoded(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode()


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_bytes())


def package_hash(directory):
    result = hashlib.sha256()
    paths = sorted(directory.rglob("*.py"))
    for path in paths:
        result.update(str(path.relative_to(directory)).encode())
        result.update(b"\0")
        result.update(path.read_bytes())
        result.update(b"\0")
    return result.hexdigest(), len(paths)


checks = collections.Counter()
failures = []


def check(group, condition, detail=None):
    checks[group] += 1
    if not condition:
        failures.append({"check": group, "detail": detail})


binding_path = ROOT / "benchmarks/experiments/round7-identifiers-binding-v2.json"
plan_path = ROOT / "benchmarks/experiments/round7-identifiers-plan.json"
data_path = ROOT / "benchmarks/fixtures/engineering_identifiers.json"
source_lock_path = ROOT / "benchmarks/fixtures/engineering_identifiers_sources.json"
competitor_lock_path = ROOT / "benchmarks/competitors/billion-round2-lock.json"
binding, plan, data = read(binding_path), read(plan_path), read(data_path)
source_lock, competitor_lock = read(source_lock_path), read(competitor_lock_path)
summary, attempts = read(RAW / "summary.json"), read(RAW / "attempts.json")
controls = plan["common_controls"]
documents = {row["id"]: row for row in data["documents"]}
queries = {row["id"]: row for row in data["queries"]}
check("binding_exact_original_bytes", binding_path.read_bytes() == (RAW / "binding.json").read_bytes())
check("summary_binding", summary["binding"] == binding)
for path, key in ((plan_path, "plan_sha256"), (data_path, "dataset_sha256"),
                  (source_lock_path, "source_lock_sha256"), (competitor_lock_path, "competitor_lock_sha256")):
    check("bound_input_hash", digest(path.read_bytes()) == binding[key], str(path.relative_to(ROOT)))
for name, value in binding["harness_sha256"].items():
    check("bound_harness_hash", digest((ROOT / name).read_bytes()) == value, name)
binding_commit = subprocess.check_output(["git", "log", "-1", "--format=%H", "--",
    str(binding_path.relative_to(ROOT))], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
committed_binding = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", binding_commit + ":" + str(binding_path.relative_to(ROOT))], cwd=ROOT)
check("registered_binding_git_bytes", committed_binding == binding_path.read_bytes())
check("source_repository_identity", (source_lock["repository"], source_lock["commit"], source_lock["truncated"])
      == (plan["upstream"]["repository"], plan["upstream"]["commit"], False))
source_records = {row["path"]: row for row in data["source_files"]}
selected_definitions = {}
expected_queries = []
for source in source_lock["files"]:
    raw = (Path(binding["source_cache"]) / source["path"]).read_bytes()
    blob = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode() + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest()
    check("upstream_git_blob", blob == source["git_blob_sha"] and len(raw) == source["bytes"], source["path"])
    if source["path"] == plan["upstream"]["license_path"]:
        check("upstream_license", data["license"] == raw.decode() and data["license_sha256"] == digest(raw))
        continue
    recorded = source_records[source["path"]]
    check("source_record", recorded == {"path": source["path"], "sha256": digest(raw),
                                        "bytes": len(raw), "git_blob_sha": blob}, source["path"])
    text = raw.decode()
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    nodes = sorted((node for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(text)) if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef)
                    or isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.col_offset == 0),
                   key=lambda node: (node.lineno, node.name))
    for node in nodes:
        identity = source["path"] + ":" + str(node.lineno)
        selected_definitions[identity] = (source["path"], node, lines, raw)
for path in plan["upstream"]["paths"]:
    ordered = sorted((item for item in selected_definitions.items() if item[1][0] == path), key=lambda item: item[1][1].lineno)
    for identity, (_, node, lines, raw) in ordered:
        doc = documents.get(identity)
        check("complete_source_selection", doc is not None, identity)
        if doc is None:
            continue
        expected_text = "".join(lines[node.lineno - 1:node.end_lineno])[:1800]
        check("original_definition_bytes", doc["text"] == expected_text and doc["title"] == node.name
              and doc["declaration"] == lines[node.lineno - 1].strip(), identity)
        check("definition_source_coordinates", doc["source"] == {"path": path, "commit": plan["upstream"]["commit"],
              "file_sha256": digest(raw), "start_line": node.lineno, "definition_end_line": node.end_lineno,
              "snippet_chars": len(expected_text)}, identity)
        if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and re.search(r"[A-Z]{2,}[a-z]", node.name):
            spaced = re.sub(r"([A-Z]+)([A-Z][a-z])", r"\1 \2", node.name)
            spaced = re.sub(r"([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", r"\1 \2", spaced).replace("_", " ")
            for variant, query in (("exact", node.name), ("spaced", spaced), ("lowercase", spaced.lower()),
                                   ("question", "Where is " + spaced + " defined?")):
                expected_queries.append({"id": identity + ":" + variant, "query": query, "variant": variant,
                                         "project": doc["project"], "expected_id": identity,
                                         "declaration": doc["declaration"]})
check("no_unregistered_documents", set(documents) == set(selected_definitions))
check("complete_query_selection", expected_queries == data["queries"])
check("declared_counts", len(documents) == binding["documents"] == 140 and len(queries) == binding["queries"] == 176)
check("registered_axes", binding["arms"] == plan["arms"] and controls["token_budgets"] == [1024, 4096]
      and controls["repetitions"] == 3 and controls["limit"] == 5)

# The matrix already populated the default cache. Make a missing cache an
# error rather than allowing the audit to download any encoding asset.
def prohibit_download(_):
    raise RuntimeError("Offline audit requires the already cached encoding")
tiktoken.load.read_file = prohibit_download
encoder = tiktoken.get_encoding(controls["tokenizer"])
check("reference_tokenizer", tiktoken.__version__ == binding["tiktoken"] == "0.12.0")

runtime_records = {}
for arm, source in binding["sources"].items():
    calculated, count = package_hash(Path(source["path"]) / "memory_book")
    check("runtime_package_hash", calculated == source["sha256"], arm)
    runtime_records[arm] = {"sha256": calculated, "python_files": count, "bound_source_path": source["path"]}
check("baseline_release_runtime", binding["sources"]["v0.3.4"]["sha256"] == plan["baseline"]["runtime_sha256"])
expected_stages = {(arm, repetition) for arm in binding["arms"] for repetition in range(controls["repetitions"])}
check("unique_stage_matrix", len(attempts) == len(expected_stages) == 15
      and {(row["arm"], row["repetition"]) for row in attempts} == expected_stages)
started, completed, finished_rows = set(), set(), []
stage_records = []
pack_digest = hashlib.sha256()
pack_cache = {}


def repack(ids, budget):
    key = tuple(ids), budget
    if key not in pack_cache:
        blocks, retained = [], []
        for identity in ids:
            doc = documents[identity]
            block = "[" + identity + "] " + doc["project"] + " | " + doc["source"]["commit"] + "\n" + doc["text"]
            proposed = "\n\n".join(blocks + [block])
            if len(encoder.encode(proposed)) > budget:
                break
            blocks.append(block)
            retained.append(identity)
        context = "\n\n".join(blocks)
        pack_cache[key] = retained, context, len(encoder.encode(context))
    return pack_cache[key]


for stage in attempts:
    arm, repetition = stage["arm"], stage["repetition"]
    directory = RAW / stage["state"]
    check("stage_identity", stage["state"] == f"{repetition}-{arm}" and stage["returncode"] == 0, stage)
    init, done = read(directory / "initialization.json"), read(directory / "completed.json")
    check("completion_marker", done == {"queries": 176, "arm": arm, "repetition": repetition}, stage["state"])
    check("initialization_identity", init["arm"] == arm, stage["state"])
    page_map = {}
    if arm in binding["sources"]:
        expected_package = str((Path(binding["sources"][arm]["path"]) / "memory_book").resolve())
        check("actual_import_identity", init["actual_import"] == {"package": expected_package,
              "store": expected_package + "/store.py"} and init["runtime_sha256"] == binding["sources"][arm]["sha256"], stage["state"])
        database = directory / "book.db"
        check("closed_database_size", database.stat().st_size == init["database_bytes"], stage["state"])
        connection = sqlite3.connect(database.as_uri() + "?mode=ro&immutable=1", uri=True)
        try:
            saved_pages = connection.execute("SELECT p.id,p.content,p.project_id,s.external_id FROM pages p JOIN sessions s ON s.id=p.session_pk").fetchall()
        finally:
            connection.close()
        check("saved_database_document_count", len(saved_pages) == len(documents), stage["state"])
        for page_id, content, project, source_id in saved_pages:
            check("saved_database_original_source", source_id in documents and project == documents[source_id]["project"]
                  and content == "ASSISTANT: " + documents[source_id]["text"], {"stage": stage["state"], "page": page_id})
            page_map[page_id] = source_id
        check("saved_database_all_sources", set(page_map.values()) == set(documents), stage["state"])
    elif arm == "billion-context-component":
        upstream = init["upstream"]
        check("billion_locked_kernel_identity", upstream["repository"] == competitor_lock["repository"]
              and upstream["commit"] == competitor_lock["commit"]
              and upstream["source_manifest_sha256"] == binding["competitor_lock_sha256"]
              and upstream["node"] == binding["node"] and upstream["documents"] == len(documents)
              and upstream["implementation"] == "unchanged upstream TypeScript; Node syntax erasure", stage["state"])
    raw = (directory / "events.jsonl").read_bytes()
    check("durable_event_boundary", raw.endswith(b"\n"), stage["state"])
    lines = raw.splitlines()
    check("stage_event_count", len(lines) == 2 * len(queries), stage["state"])
    observed_order = []
    for line_index, line in enumerate(lines):
        row = json.loads(line)
        key = (arm, repetition, row["query_id"])
        detail = {"stage": stage["state"], "query_id": row["query_id"], "line": line_index + 1}
        check("event_matrix_identity", row["arm"] == arm and row["repetition"] == repetition and row["query_id"] in queries, detail)
        if row["event"] == "started":
            check("unique_started_event", key not in started and key not in completed and line_index % 2 == 0, detail)
            started.add(key)
            observed_order.append(row["query_id"])
            continue
        check("unique_completed_event", row["event"] == "completed" and key in started and key not in completed
              and line_index % 2 == 1 and observed_order[-1] == row["query_id"], detail)
        completed.add(key)
        case = queries[row["query_id"]]
        check("frozen_query_metadata", all(row[k] == case[k] for k in ("query", "variant", "expected_id")), detail)
        ids = row["hit_ids"]
        check("valid_selected_sources", len(ids) <= controls["limit"] and len(set(ids)) == len(ids)
              and all(identity in documents and documents[identity]["project"] == case["project"] for identity in ids), detail)
        check("no_search_error", row["error"] is None, detail)
        check("saved_timing_validity", type(row["lookup_wall_ms"]) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(row["lookup_wall_ms"])
              and row["lookup_wall_ms"] >= 0, detail)
        payload = row["native_payload"]
        if arm in binding["sources"]:
            mapped = []
            check("native_book_request", payload["query"] == case["query"] and payload["cache_hit"] is False
                  and payload["budget_chars"] == 100000 and row["native_ms"] == payload["latency_ms"], detail)
            for hit in payload["results"]:
                ref_ids = {ref["session_id"] for ref in hit["source_refs"]}
                check("native_book_unique_source", len(ref_ids) == 1, detail)
                source_id = next(iter(ref_ids))
                original_text = "ASSISTANT: " + documents[source_id]["text"]
                check("native_book_page_mapping", page_map.get(hit["id"]) == source_id, detail)
                check("native_book_original_text", hit["text"] == original_text
                      and hit["page_chars"] == len(original_text)
                      and hit["excerpt_spans"] == [[0, len(original_text)]] and hit["truncated"] is False, detail)
                check("native_book_source_coordinates", all(ref["project"] == case["project"] and ref["turn_index"] == 0
                      and ref["start"] == ref["turn_start"] == 0
                      and ref["end"] == ref["turn_end"] == len(original_text) for ref in hit["source_refs"]), detail)
                mapped.append(source_id)
            check("native_book_ids", mapped == ids, detail)
        elif arm == "billion-context-component":
            check("native_billion_ids", [hit["ref"] for hit in payload["results"]] == ids
                  and row["native_ms"] == payload["search_ms"], detail)
        elif arm == "no-memory":
            check("no_memory_no_payload", ids == [] and payload is None and row["native_ms"] is None, detail)
        else:
            check("raw_search_payload_boundary", payload is None and row["native_ms"] is None, detail)
        check("unique_budget_cells", [score["budget_tokens"] for score in row["scores"]] == controls["token_budgets"], detail)
        reconstructed = []
        for budget, score in zip(controls["token_budgets"], row["scores"]):
            retained, context, tokens = repack(ids, budget)
            rank = ids.index(case["expected_id"]) + 1 if case["expected_id"] in ids else None
            expected = {"budget_tokens": budget, "retained_ids": retained, "context": context,
                        "context_tokens": tokens, "hit": case["expected_id"] in retained and case["declaration"] in context,
                        "top1": bool(ids and ids[0] == case["expected_id"]),
                        "reciprocal_rank": 1 / rank if rank else 0, "budget_violation": tokens > budget}
            check("independent_original_pack_and_scores", score == expected and not expected["budget_violation"], {**detail, "budget": budget})
            pack_digest.update(encoded({"key": key, "score": expected}) + b"\n")
            reconstructed.append(expected)
        finished_rows.append({**row, "scores": reconstructed})
    stage_records.append({"arm": arm, "repetition": repetition, "state": stage["state"],
                          "events": len(lines), "completed_calls": len(observed_order), "returncode": stage["returncode"],
                          "initialization_sha256": digest((directory / "initialization.json").read_bytes()),
                          "events_sha256": digest(raw), "query_order_sha256": digest(encoded(observed_order))})
expected_keys = {(arm, repetition, identity) for arm, repetition in expected_stages for identity in queries}
check("complete_call_matrix", started == completed == expected_keys and len(finished_rows) == binding["quality_calls"] == 2640)
retrieval_calls = sum(row["arm"] != "no-memory" for row in finished_rows)
empty_controls = sum(row["arm"] == "no-memory" for row in finished_rows)
check("observation_vs_retrieval_count", retrieval_calls == 2112 and empty_controls == 528
      and retrieval_calls + empty_controls == len(finished_rows))
for repetition in range(3):
    check("paired_query_order", len({r["query_order_sha256"] for r in stage_records if r["repetition"] == repetition}) == 1, repetition)

groups = collections.defaultdict(list)
for row in finished_rows:
    for score in row["scores"]:
        groups[(row["arm"], row["variant"], score["budget_tokens"])].append((row, score))
reconstructed_cells = []
summary_cells = {(cell["arm"], cell["variant"], cell["budget_tokens"]): cell for cell in summary["cells"]}
for key, values in sorted(groups.items()):
    arm, variant, budget = key
    denominator = sum(case["variant"] == variant for case in queries.values()) * controls["repetitions"]
    times = sorted(row["lookup_wall_ms"] for row, _ in values)
    cell = {"arm": arm, "variant": variant, "budget_tokens": budget, "observations": len(values),
            "expected_observations": denominator, "distinct_queries": len({row["query_id"] for row, _ in values}),
            "hit_rate": sum(score["hit"] for _, score in values) / denominator,
            "top1_rate": sum(score["top1"] for _, score in values) / denominator,
            "mrr": sum(score["reciprocal_rank"] for _, score in values) / denominator,
            "mean_context_tokens": statistics.fmean(score["context_tokens"] for _, score in values),
            "mean_lookup_ms": statistics.fmean(times), "p95_lookup_ms": times[min(len(times) - 1, int(.95 * len(times)))],
            "errors": sum(row["error"] is not None for row, _ in values) + max(0, denominator - len(values)),
            "budget_violations": sum(score["budget_violation"] for _, score in values)}
    check("independent_aggregate_cell", cell == summary_cells.get(key), key)
    reconstructed_cells.append(cell)
check("complete_summary_axes", len(summary_cells) == len(reconstructed_cells) == 40 and set(summary_cells) == set(groups))

def metric(arm, variants, budget):
    selected = [cell for cell in reconstructed_cells if cell["arm"] == arm and cell["variant"] in variants and cell["budget_tokens"] == budget]
    return sum(cell["hit_rate"] * cell["expected_observations"] for cell in selected) / sum(cell["expected_observations"] for cell in selected)
before = metric("v0.3.4", ("spaced", "lowercase"), 1024)
after = metric("round7-candidate", ("spaced", "lowercase"), 1024)
exact_checks = [{"budget_tokens": budget, "before": metric("v0.3.4", ("exact",), budget),
                 "after": metric("round7-candidate", ("exact",), budget)} for budget in controls["token_budgets"]]
numeric = after - before >= .10 - 1e-12 and all(value["after"] >= value["before"] for value in exact_checks)
check("independent_gate", numeric == summary["bounded_numerical_gate_passed"]
      and exact_checks == summary["exact_name_nonregression"]
      and (after - before) * 100 == summary["spaced_lowercase_1024_delta_percentage_points"])
check("summary_completion", summary["completed"] is True and summary["observed_calls"] == summary["expected_calls"] == 2640
      and summary["missing_completed_cells"] == 0 and summary["protocol_errors"] == [] and summary["attempts"] == attempts)
check("no_model_or_release_claim", summary["generated_answers"] == summary["generated_patches"] == binding["model_calls"] == 0
      and summary["release_approved"] is False)
raw_files = {str(path.relative_to(RAW)): {"bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": digest(path.read_bytes())}
             for path in sorted(RAW.rglob("*")) if path.is_file()}
check("complete_raw_inventory", len(raw_files) == 69)
for name, value in binding["harness_sha256"].items():
    check("harness_unchanged_after_saved_audit", digest((ROOT / name).read_bytes()) == value, name)
report = {"schema_version": 1, "status": "passed" if not failures else "failed", "passed": not failures,
          "scope": "Independent saved-record integrity and common-pack recomputation; no product or model execution",
          "binding_path": str(binding_path.relative_to(ROOT)), "binding_commit": binding_commit,
          "binding_sha256": digest(binding_path.read_bytes()), "plan_sha256": binding["plan_sha256"],
          "dataset_sha256": binding["dataset_sha256"], "source_lock_sha256": binding["source_lock_sha256"],
          "original_results_directory": str(RAW.relative_to(ROOT)), "intended_archive_prefix": ARCHIVE_PREFIX,
          "archive_format": "tar.xz", "archive_filename": "raw.tar.xz",
          "archive_equality": "Original relative paths and SHA256 below must match archive-manifest.json and extracted raw.tar.xz; archival is performed separately by root",
          "runtime_identities": runtime_records, "counts": {"source_files": 9, "documents": len(documents),
          "queries": len(queries), "stages": len(stage_records), "observations": len(finished_rows),
          "actual_retrieval_calls": retrieval_calls, "no_memory_empty_controls": empty_controls,
          "started_events": len(started), "completed_events": len(completed), "budget_score_cells": 2 * len(finished_rows),
          "aggregate_cells": len(reconstructed_cells), "raw_files": len(raw_files),
          "raw_bytes": sum(value["bytes"] for value in raw_files.values())},
          "checks": dict(checks), "checks_passed": sum(checks.values()) - len(failures), "failures": failures,
          "observation_count_interpretation": "The frozen binding calls its 2640 matrix observations quality_calls. Only 2112 invoke a retrieval engine or raw-text search; the remaining 528 are no-memory empty controls and do not call any engine.",
          "independent_pack_sha256": pack_digest.hexdigest(), "stages": stage_records,
          "independently_reconstructed_cells": reconstructed_cells,
          "bounded_numerical_gate_passed": numeric and not failures,
          "spaced_lowercase_1024_delta_percentage_points": (after - before) * 100,
          "exact_name_nonregression": exact_checks, "raw_files": raw_files,
          "new_product_calls": 0, "new_model_calls": 0, "new_timing_runs": 0,
          "publication_approved": False,
          "limitations": ["Real source snippets with automatically authored identifier queries; single-repository hypothesis-aligned retrieval pilot",
              "No generated answers, patches, task-test success, longitudinal user evaluation or universal competitor advantage",
              "Lookup timing and initialization boundaries differ across engines; audit rechecks saved arithmetic only",
              "Actual-import and kernel launch provenance is corroborated by saved metadata, bound code and saved Book archives, not external process attestation",
              "Search ranking was not rerun; original selected IDs were independently mapped and repacked",
              "Repeated queries and variants are correlated, not independent real-user tasks"],
          "auditor": {"implementation": "Independent standard-library plus cached tiktoken audit; does not import the frozen harness or product",
              "source_sha256": digest(Path(__file__).read_bytes()), "source": Path(__file__).read_text()}}
DESTINATION.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with DESTINATION.open("x", encoding="utf8") as stream:
    json.dump(report, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
    stream.write("\n")
print(json.dumps({"path": str(DESTINATION.relative_to(ROOT)), "passed": report["passed"], "checks": sum(checks.values()),
                  "failures": failures[:10], "counts": report["counts"], "sha256": digest(DESTINATION.read_bytes())}))
sys.exit(0 if report["passed"] else 2)
